headings: ともし・い【▽乏しい／▽羨しい】
qualifiedClaims: Both exact adjective headings are present. とぼしい has insufficiency and financial-poverty senses; the ともしい entry explicitly redirects its first two senses to those respective senses.
The main entry supplies a predicate using 人材 and an attributive phrase using 経験. This supports both 人材が乏しい and 乏しい経験 as construction models, not an unrestricted collocation rule.
The financial sense includes a 生活 phrase. Financial poverty is not an invalid meaning of 乏しい, and 貧しい is not restricted to money in the frozen comparison family.

The source classifies both as adjectives and separately supplies classical forms. Contemporary 乏しい is an い-adjective, not a な-adjective. A draft can use the attested predicate/adnominal patterns and ordinary 乏しくない or 乏しかった inflections without inventing a な connector.

The ともしい heading includes an attributed travel-expense quotation for insufficiency and a separate living-circumstances example. Its later attraction/envy senses have classical quotations; do not transfer these senses to the planned とぼしい support article.
sources.alternateReadingDisposition: Recognized alternate, not an invented spelling or a name reading. Retain とも.しい in full metadata and explain 乏しい（ともしい） in its own reading row. Do not silently link that row as though words/乏しい.md had primary reading ともしい. Recognition-only treatment is sufficient for the proposed two-word support set; no separate duplicate lexical identity is needed.
sources.limits: Relative present-day frequency and register of ともしい remain UNVERIFIED. Neither missing JMdict priority nor classical examples for different senses establishes that the insufficiency reading is archaic or rare. The ▽ notation is recorded but not interpreted without its notation guide. No historical sound-change explanation is needed in the teaching.

sources.heading: びん‐ぼう〔‐ボフ〕【貧乏】
qualifiedClaims: The exact split heading confirms びんぼう. The definition concerns insufficient assets or income making life difficult, not cheap merchandise or a person's moral worth.

The entry identifies noun, adjectival-noun and suru uses. It supplies both a な-before-person example and a joblessness/suru example, agreeing with the complete frozen JMdict noun/na-adjective/intransitive-suru family.
For a bounded support article, explain 貧乏な + noun, predicative 貧乏です, and the noun meaning poverty. Suru can be mentioned as a recognized use without manufacturing an unrelated transitive operation.
貧 and 乏 reinforce poverty/lack in this compound. The existing 貧 card independently records ビン with 貧乏; the separate 乏 entry gives ボウ and names the compound.
sources.limits: No claim that every 貧乏 expression is interchangeable with 貧しい. Do not use the neighboring religious/Wikipedia/Wiktionary sections as the publisher of this definition. Irregular 貧之 and no-kanji ビンボー in frozen JMdict are not additional neutral kanji-spelling models.
